name: macpaint
title: macpaint
blurb: a 1-bit MacPaint tribute — pencil, bucket, spray can, and Susan Kare-style dither patterns, right in your browser. also speaks a tiny text drawing language (PEN/LINE/RECT/FILL/...) so an LLM can paint by writing a script instead of diffusing pixels: copy the built-in prompt into any chat, paste back what it writes, and watch it draw. asked for by evelyn.willalways.top, seconded by bisks.net.
